FACT_13_DESC: Red appears on many national flags, including those of Canada, Japan and Switzerland.
FACT_17_DESC: The five Olympic rings and their white background use six colours, chosen to represent the flags of nations around the world.
FACT_18_DESC: Mexico’s flag shows an eagle on a cactus holding a snake.
FACT_19_DESC: Monaco and Indonesia both use red above white on their flags, but the flags have different proportions.
FACT_20_DESC: The United States flag has 50 stars, one for each state.
FACT_22_DESC: A cross appears on many national flags, including those of Denmark, Finland and Switzerland.
FACT_24_DESC: The crescent appears on several national flags, including those of Turkey, Pakistan and Tunisia.
FACT_26_DESC: Lebanon’s national flag features a cedar tree.
FACT_27_DESC: Qatar’s national flag has a height-to-width ratio of 11:28.
FACT_30_DESC: Cambodia’s national flag depicts the temple of Angkor Wat.
FACT_33_DESC: Some national flags contain no blue, including those of Jamaica, Japan and Switzerland.
FACT_48_DESC: Japan’s national flag features a red circle representing the sun on a white background.
FACT_50_DESC: Five stars on Australia’s flag represent the Southern Cross constellation.
HELP_STREAK_TEXT:
Your streak tracks consecutive days of play.

• Play at least one game each day to keep it growing.
• Streak freezes can protect missed days when available.
• Open your streak calendar to see your played days and available protection.

Regular practice helps build a learning habit!
HELP_LEAGUES_TEXT:
Leagues let you compete with other players.

From lowest to highest:
• Bronze
• Silver
• Gold
• Platinum
• Diamond
• Master

Your weekly position determines whether you move up, stay or move down. Promotion and demotion zones depend on your progress and are shown in the league table. You earn F-Bucks for promotion.
HELP_TECH_DATA_SYNC:
Your progress is saved automatically on your device. The app can also mirror local progress through iCloud when it is available for your Apple Account.

• Keep your device backups up to date.
• Use the same Apple Account when restoring iCloud progress.
• You can export your game data from the app’s privacy settings.

After changing devices, check that your progress has been restored before deleting your old backup.
HELP_NOTIFICATIONS_TYPES:
The app supports daily practice reminders, streak reminders, friend reminders, duel invitations and results.

Use the app’s notification settings to choose the reminders you want. Your device settings control whether World Arena Flags can show notifications.

Daily reminders can help you remember to practise.
HELP_PROFILE_AVATAR:
To change your avatar:
1. Open Profile and tap your avatar to edit your profile.
2. Open the avatar editor or choose a photo from your library.
3. Adjust your avatar or crop the photo.
4. Save your changes.
HELP_PROFILE_SKIN_EDITOR:
Use the avatar editor to customise your appearance: clothing, accessories, glasses, skin tone, hair and facial features.

Open your profile, tap your avatar and open the avatar editor. Choose a category and select an item to see it in the preview. Save your changes to apply them to your profile.

Items marked with a lock may require progress or F-Bucks to unlock.
HELP_TECH_FLAGS_NOT_LOADING:
If flags are not loading:
1. Check your internet connection.
2. Restart the app.
3. Install the latest app update.
4. Contact support if the problem persists.
